faculty_decisions.FD-RATIFY-07: GI pressure calibration is CLOSED FOR DEVELOPMENT unless a cross-family contradiction, a dangerous educational effect, a failure under a new intervention or a failure of generalization appears

coordinates.bleed_rate: never a coordinate: always c x scale (FD-RATE-17)
coordinates.c: bleed rate / preload scale, per minute
coordinates.kernel: (e, s, tau) of the crystalloid retention kernel

projections_are_not_ranges.warning: a rate from one end with a scale from the other is OUTSIDE the region: only c x scale pairs inside A are points

structure_preserved.rule: the region is ratified as the CORRELATED object it is (rate = c x scale, with the crystalloid kernel); it is not flattened into independent rate and scale ranges, because a rate from one end with a scale from the other is outside it
